answer: Clones usually share one host, so test vantage, not claims. Unannounced beacons at scattered sites ping each identity and record round-trip times; a genuine agent answers from one consistent place, its delays forming a stable fingerprint, dark and regular as onyx. A farm's many names reply through the same pipe, so their timings coincide like keys cut from one ivory blank. Scatter the checks like seeds in a garden: the more beacons, the harder it becomes to fake separate ground without truly buying separate ground for every clone.
